With the trend of Urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for Nature. As concrete forests expand, many urban dwellers rarely feel the breeze, hear birds, or touch soil. A stronger bond with nature is not a luxury; it is essential for mental and physical well-being in an increasingly artificial environment.
One practical way to cultivate this love is to make nature part of daily routines. For example, residents can walk in nearby parks, grow plants on balconies, or join community gardening projects. These activities reconnect people with the living world. Last year, I started visiting a small riverbank park every weekend. Watching seasons change there reduced my stress and made me more aware of environmental protection.
Therefore, city governments and individuals should work together to create more green spaces and spend time in them. Only by integrating nature into urban life can residents truly develop a stronger love for it and build healthier cities for future generations.

lines.en: M: Welcome to "Business Matters". Today we have invited career development consultant Lucy Williams to talk about how to get ahead at work. Hi, Lucy. Many of us never seem to get promoted. Why is that? And what can we do about it?
lines.zh: M: 欢迎收听《商业纵横》。今天我们邀请了职业发展顾问露西·威廉姆斯，来谈谈如何在职场上取得成功。你好，露西。我们很多人似乎一直得不到晋升，这是为什么？我们又能做些什么呢？

lines.en: W: One mistake people make is to limit communication only to their bosses. It's important to expand your network and include your co-workers.
lines.zh: W: 人们常犯的一个错误，是把沟通对象局限在自己的上司。拓展人际网络很重要，也要把同事纳入其中。

lines.en: M: But some of our co-workers are less senior to us. Is it really necessary to connect with them?
lines.zh: M: 但我们有些同事的职位比我们低。真的有必要和他们建立联系吗？

lines.en: W: It's important not to underestimate your colleagues. Sometimes a job title might not clearly demonstrate the influence they may have.
lines.zh: W: 重要的是不要低估你的同事。有时候，职位名称并不能清楚地体现他们可能拥有的影响力。

lines.en: M: Now many of us think that working hard creates a good impression, but this isn't always true, is it?
lines.zh: M: 现在我们很多人都认为努力工作会给别人留下好印象，但事实并不总是如此，对吧？

lines.en: W: That's right. We should avoid trying to take on too much work and constantly staying late, just to show that you are committed.
lines.zh: W: 没错。我们应该避免为了表现出自己的投入，就试图承担过多的工作，还总是加班到很晚。

lines.en: M: I see. So setting expectations too high at the beginning can make us look bad if we don't maintain them.
lines.zh: M: 我明白了。所以，一开始就把别人对我们的期待设得太高，如果后来无法保持，就可能让我们看起来很糟糕。

lines.en: W: Yeah, it's better to make sure you are putting in quality time instead of just a large quantity of time. And these efforts can easily be demonstrated by the results we achieve.
lines.zh: W: 是的，最好确保自己投入的是高质量的时间，而不只是大量的时间。而且，我们取得的成果很容易证明这些努力。

lines.en: M: What about helping others at work? Should you try and go beyond your normal responsibilities and offer to help people with their projects?
lines.zh: M: 那么，在工作中帮助别人呢？你是否应该尽力超越自己的日常职责，主动提出帮助别人完成项目？

lines.en: W: Extend your assistance to those who need it, but only as long as your own work will not go unattended. If someone can benefit from your assistance or advice, help them out to gain their respect and trust.
lines.zh: W: 向那些需要帮助的人提供援助，但前提是不能让自己的工作无人处理。如果有人能从你的帮助或建议中获益，就帮他们一把，以赢得他们的尊重和信任。

lines.en: M: But it goes without saying that you shouldn't act like a know-it-all, otherwise you'll appear arrogant.
lines.zh: M: 不过，显而易见，你不应该表现得像个无所不知的人，否则会显得傲慢。

lines.en: W: Absolutely. Be humble, and you'll get a lot of time later on to show your genius.
lines.zh: W: 当然。保持谦逊，之后你会有很多时间展现自己的才华。

lines.en: W: I think we first need to decide how to divide up the presentation responsibilities. From what I recall, the presentation consists of five parts, not including the introduction and conclusion. That would mean altogether, we need to allocate seven parts between the two of us.
lines.zh: W: 我觉得我们首先需要决定如何分配演示的任务。据我所记得，这次演示由五个部分组成，不包括开头和结尾。也就是说，我们总共需要在我们两个人之间分配七个部分。

lines.en: M: So, we have the abstract, background research, the project design, the results and the discussion portions. As the abstract section only applies to the article, we needn't include it in the presentation. How would you suggest we dole out the rest?
lines.zh: M: 所以，我们有摘要、背景研究、项目设计、结果和讨论这几个部分。由于摘要部分只适用于文章，我们不必把它包括在演示中。你建议我们如何分配剩下的部分？

lines.en: W: How do you feel about handling the background bit? In this way, we can both discuss the part of the project that we devoted most of our time to.
lines.zh: W: 你觉得由你来负责背景研究部分怎么样？这样一来，我们就都可以讲述自己投入最多时间的项目部分了。

lines.en: M: Hold on a minute. You want me, the one who did the bulk of the task, to also do the majority of the presentation? The background research which was so meticulous took more than a month.
lines.zh: M: 等一下。你是想让我这个承担了大部分任务的人，再负责演示的大部分内容？那份一丝不苟的背景研究花了一个多月的时间。

lines.en: W: OK. OK. I get it. Quit your moaning. I appreciate the rigorous work ethic you applied to the research, but not the sarcasm that comes up every time I mention it. What do you think would be a fair arrangement?
lines.zh: W: 好了，好了。我明白了。别再抱怨了。我认可你在研究中所表现出的严谨工作态度，但不欣赏每次我提到这件事时你表现出的讽刺。你觉得怎样分配才公平？

lines.en: M: I think the best arrangement would be to split the research into two parts: before-1980 and afterward. I would take the before-portion and you would be assigned the after-1980, leaving the project and results. I volunteer to describe the project. But as I struggled a bit with the statistics in the results section, how about you handling that?
lines.zh: M: 我觉得最好的安排是把研究分成两部分：1980年以前和之后。我负责1980年以前的部分，你负责1980年以后的部分，项目设计和结果部分则另行分配。我自愿介绍项目设计。不过，我在结果部分的统计数据方面有些吃力，你来负责那一部分怎么样？

lines.en: W: That's agreeable to me. I propose we both handle the discussion section in parts along with the question and answer afterward, leaving only the introduction and conclusion.
lines.zh: W: 我觉得这样可以。我提议我们分段负责讨论部分，之后的问答环节也由我们共同完成，这样就只剩下开头和结尾了。

lines.en: M: I will take responsibility for the conclusion and put you in charge of the introduction. This will make it so that we alternate presenting, so as to avoid sounding monotonous to the audience.
lines.zh: M: 我来负责结尾，你来负责开头。这样我们就可以交替进行演示，避免让听众觉得单调。

lines.en: Makeup can do more than just change your appearance—it can also alter others' perceptions of you, for better or for worse. According to new research from the University of Stirling in Scotland, although both men and women perceive women who wear makeup as being of a higher status, men associate makeup with prestigious, positive qualities, while women view other women wearing makeup as being dominant and a potential threat.
lines.zh: 化妆不仅能改变你的外表，还能改变他人对你的看法，结果可能更好，也可能更糟。根据苏格兰斯特灵大学的一项新研究，虽然男性和女性都认为化妆的女性地位更高，但男性会将化妆与有声望、积极的品质联系起来，而女性则认为化妆的其他女性更具支配性，并可能构成威胁。

lines.en: The research showed that men and women both rated the faces with cosmetics as being more attractive, but only women rated made-up faces as being more dominant, while only men rated made-up faces as being higher in prestige.
lines.zh: 研究表明，男性和女性都认为化妆后的面孔更具吸引力，但只有女性认为化妆后的面孔更具支配性，只有男性认为化妆后的面孔具有更高的声望。

lines.en: A follow-up study investigated the root cause behind these differences in perception, and found that female-on-female jealousy seemed to be the main cause of the differences in perception. Women rating women with makeup said they would be more jealous of them and thought they would be more attractive to men than their non-makeup wearing counterparts.
lines.zh: 一项后续研究探究了这些认知差异背后的根本原因，发现女性之间的嫉妒似乎是造成这种认知差异的主要原因。对化妆女性进行评价的女性表示，她们会更嫉妒这些女性，并认为相比不化妆的女性，她们对男性更具吸引力。

lines.en: Cosmetic products are good for more than just giving you a pretty face. It can be particularly useful for women to understand how wearing makeup alters others' perceptions of them in situations where they are trying to gain others' trust and admiration. At a job interview, knowing whether the hiring committee will consist of men or women might influence a female candidate's decision about wearing makeup. Whether the interviewers will view her as attractive, dominant and prestigious can affect the interviewers' actions and perhaps the outcome of the interview itself.
lines.zh: 化妆品的作用不只是让你拥有一张漂亮的脸。对于女性而言，了解化妆如何改变他人对自己的看法，尤其是在试图赢得他人的信任和钦佩时，可能非常有用。在求职面试中，了解招聘委员会由男性还是女性组成，可能会影响女性求职者是否化妆的决定。面试官是否会认为她具有吸引力、支配性和声望，可能会影响面试官的行为，甚至可能影响面试本身的结果。

lines.en: You may have seen advertisements trumpeting methods of changing a habit that require absolutely no willpower whatsoever. But can you really change a bad habit or create a good one without willpower? To answer this question, we first have to ask: "What is willpower?" Most people, sadly, think of it only as the ability to clench their teeth and resist attractive temptations. In this view, willpower means self-denial and no fun. No wonder people hope to make changes without it.
lines.zh: 你可能见过一些广告大肆宣扬无需任何意志力就能改变习惯的方法。但你真的能够在没有意志力的情况下改掉坏习惯或养成好习惯吗？要回答这个问题，我们首先必须问：“什么是意志力？”遗憾的是，大多数人只把它看作咬紧牙关、抵制诱人诱惑的能力。在这种看法中，意志力意味着自我克制和毫无乐趣。难怪人们希望不借助意志力就能做出改变。

lines.en: I define willpower as "using only the thought of your motivators to control your actions." Let's say your motivators are "prevent diabetes" and "reach a healthy weight". So if you are at the all-you-can-eat buffet, you think about your motivator—avoid diabetes through weight loss—and you take small portions and avoid the dessert table.
lines.zh: 我把意志力定义为“仅凭想到自己的动机来控制行为”。假设你的动机是“预防糖尿病”和“达到健康体重”。那么，当你在自助餐厅面对不限量供应的食物时，你会想到自己的动机——通过减重来避免糖尿病——于是少量取食，并避开甜点区。

lines.en: So, amazingly enough, willpower begins with a thought—a bright idea—some way to improve your life or contribute to others. This bright idea is your motivator.
lines.zh: 所以，令人惊讶的是，意志力始于一个想法——一个改善生活或为他人做出贡献的好主意。这个好主意就是你的动机。

lines.en: Doctor Walter Mischel, an expert on willpower skills, uses the expressive term "a burning goal". Whether you call it a motivator, a burning goal, or a bright idea, this idea is the force behind your willpower.
lines.zh: 意志力技能专家沃尔特·米歇尔博士使用了“一个燃烧的目标”这一生动的说法。无论你把它称为动机、燃烧的目标，还是好主意，这个想法都是意志力背后的力量。

lines.en: What sort of bright ideas—motivators—make for effective willpower? In fact, any goal that you value strongly counts. The list may include good health, self-respect, a better future for your family, a personal mission and being a role model for your child. All these can certainly drive a positive change.
lines.zh: 什么样的好主意——也就是动机——能够产生有效的意志力？事实上，任何一个你高度重视的目标都算在内。这个清单可能包括良好的健康状况、自尊、为家人创造更美好的未来、个人使命，以及成为孩子的榜样。所有这些都确实能够推动积极的改变。

lines.en: For many pregnant women, understanding what seafood is safe and healthy and what should be avoided because of mercury concerns comes with a lot of worrying. In part, that's because the federal government's advice on the matter, first issued in 2004, has long been criticized as vague. That guidance has included advice on how much seafood to eat, and which species pregnant and breastfeeding women should avoid over concerns about mercury contamination. But critics say the government advisory has done more harm than good, scaring many pregnant and breastfeeding women away from eating seafood altogether.
lines.zh: 对许多孕妇来说，了解哪些海产品安全且有益健康，以及哪些海产品因担心汞而应当避免，会带来许多忧虑。部分原因在于，联邦政府首次于2004年发布的相关建议长期以来一直被批评含糊不清。该指导意见包括关于应食用多少海产品，以及孕妇和哺乳期女性因担心汞污染而应避免哪些种类的建议。但批评者表示，政府的这份指导意见弊大于利，使许多孕妇和哺乳期女性彻底不敢食用海产品。

lines.en: The problem is real. According to a spokesman for the Food and Drug Administration, or FDA for short, the agency analyzed fish consumption data from more than 1,000 pregnant women in the US and found that 21 per cent of them ate no fish whatsoever in the previous month. And those who did eat fish consumed far less than recommended by the dietary guidelines. Some 50 per cent ate less than two ounces a week and 75 per cent ate less than four ounces.
lines.zh: 这个问题确实存在。据美国食品药品监督管理局（简称FDA）一位发言人介绍，该机构分析了美国一千多名孕妇的鱼类食用数据，发现其中21%在前一个月完全没有吃鱼。而那些吃鱼的人，摄入量也远低于膳食指南的建议。约50%的人每周摄入量少于两盎司，75%的人少于四盎司。

lines.en: This week the FDA issued an update to the advice, listing more than sixty species in a chart that ranks fish as A Best Choice, Good Choice and Choices to Avoid. The goal is to make it easier for mothers-to-be to feel confident about the type of seafood they include in their diets. The new advice recommends consumers choose a variety of fish to eat, and it comes with an easy-to-understand illustration of what an appropriate portion size should be—four ounces for an adult and two ounces for children aged four to seven.
lines.zh: 本周，FDA更新了相关建议，在一张图表中列出六十多种鱼类，并将其分为“最佳选择”“不错的选择”和“应避免的选择”。此举旨在让准妈妈更容易对自己饮食中所摄入的海产品种类感到放心。新建议推荐消费者食用多种鱼类，并配有一幅易于理解的图示，说明适当的食用分量应为多少：成年人四盎司，四至七岁的儿童两盎司。

lines.en: And while expectant mothers have long been warned to stay away from shark and four other particular types of fish from the Gulf of Mexico, now there are three new species on the list of what to avoid. But not everyone is thrilled with the new advice. Critics say the new advice doesn't always agree with the agency's own scientific findings. While mercury is of great concern when people are talking about pregnant women and seafood, it's not the only factor contributing to anxiety.
lines.zh: 长期以来，准妈妈一直被告诫要避开鲨鱼以及另外四种来自墨西哥湾的特定鱼类，而现在，又有三种鱼类被列入应避免食用的名单。但并非所有人都对这份新建议感到满意。批评者表示，新建议并不总是与该机构自己的科学研究结果一致。人们谈论孕妇和海产品时，汞确实是非常令人担忧的因素，但它并不是导致焦虑的唯一因素。

lines.en: The FDA maintains that its final consumption recommendations were based on thorough scientific analysis. Agency spokesman Cassell says the FDA believes their recommendations will increase confidence, not uncertainty. But critics disagree. They think the FDA's advice is not based on the evidence in its own detailed report, and so it confuses everyone.
lines.zh: FDA坚持认为，其最终的食用建议是基于全面的科学分析制定的。该机构发言人Cassell表示，FDA相信这些建议将增强信心，而不是增加不确定性。但批评者对此并不认同。他们认为，FDA的建议并没有以其自身那份详细报告中的证据为依据，因此让所有人都感到困惑。

lines.en: I know you're busy with work, but you also need to take some time off to recharge those batteries. So, should you plan one big vacation for the year, or should you take multiple short vacations throughout? Quantity can sometimes beat quality. First and foremost, regardless of how you use your vacation days, you need to be using them, and soon. The longer you put off your time off, the worse you're making things for yourself.
lines.zh: 我知道你忙于工作，但你也需要抽出一些时间休息，让自己的精力得到恢复。那么，你应该为这一年安排一次长假，还是应该在全年安排多次短假？数量有时胜过质量。首先，无论你如何使用假期，都需要真正使用它们，而且要尽快使用。你越是推迟休假，就越是在让自己的处境变得糟糕。

lines.en: One 9-year-long study published in Psychosomatic Medicine suggests not taking at least one vacation a year may increase your risk of mortality due to heart disease. So, not only are you killing your joy, you're possibly killing yourself. Give yourself a break, folks.
lines.zh: 《心身医学》发表的一项为期9年的研究表明，每年至少不休一次假，可能会增加因心脏病死亡的风险。所以，你不仅是在扼杀自己的快乐，也可能是在置自己于死地。各位，给自己放个假吧。

lines.en: When you should take those breaks, however, depends on a few factors: how many days you have available to use, what activities bring you joy, whether you have a family or not, and other variables come into play. Because of that, there's no perfect formula that works for everyone, but there are still a few things everyone can try to shoot for. We know that in terms of maximizing relaxation, you should aim for vacations that range somewhere between 7 and 11 days long. That gives you enough time to let go of your stress at work, completely loosen up, and achieve full-on calm.
lines.zh: 不过，你应该在什么时候休假，取决于几个因素：你有多少天可用假期、哪些活动能给你带来快乐、你是否有家庭，以及其他会产生影响的变量。正因为如此，并不存在适用于所有人的完美公式，但还是有几件事是每个人都可以努力做到的。我们知道，就最大限度地放松而言，你应该争取安排7到11天的假期。这样你就有足够的时间摆脱工作压力，彻底放松下来，达到完全平静的状态。

lines.en: That above-mentioned study also recommends you space out your vacations evenly instead of using up all of your days at once. Eight days might sound like a lot for someone who only gets 10 days of vacation a year. But if you frame them with weekends, you can manage two evenly spaced 8-day vacations a year. If you have 14 days of paid leave, that's almost three separate 8-day vacations you can use to split your year into thirds.
lines.zh: 上述研究还建议你把假期均匀地分散开来，而不是一次性用完所有假期。对于一年只有10天假期的人来说，8天听起来可能很多。但如果把周末安排在假期前后，你一年就可以安排两次间隔均匀的8天假期。如果你有14天带薪休假，那几乎可以安排三次分别为8天的假期，用来把一年分成三个阶段。

lines.en: As tempting as it might be to use all your days to take one long summer break, your overall goal should be to achieve the perfect balance between length plus joy and frequency. Vacation frequency is important because planning multiple breaks throughout the year means you always have something to look forward to. Planning things and the anticipation that comes with it tend to make us happier. If you only take one long vacation every year, the excitement builds much more slowly and seems so far off that it can actually lead to feelings of despair.
lines.zh: 尽管把所有假期都用来享受一次漫长的暑假可能很有吸引力，但你的总体目标应该是在假期长度、愉悦感和休假频率之间取得完美平衡。休假频率很重要，因为在全年安排多次休息意味着你总有值得期待的事情。筹划事情以及随之而来的期待往往会让我们更加快乐。如果你每年只休一次长假，兴奋感会积累得慢得多，而且由于假期看起来遥不可及，实际上可能会让人产生绝望感。

lines.en: Autonomous cars that can take over from drivers if they are tired or caught in the heat of an argument are being developed in Sweden. Researchers working as part of the European Union's €77 billion research program are developing sensor-based systems that monitor whether a driver is distracted, anxious or tired. If a driver is not in a fit state to be on the road, the car automatically takes control of the wheel to prevent accidents. Doctor Anna Anund from the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, who is leading the project, said a driver's state can be measured using a number of sensors, including heart rate monitors and eye sensors, which track where a driver's gaze is. She said the aim was to really make sure that the transition from the driver to the vehicle is done in a safe way, so we can take into consideration the driver's state, and so we do not give control to a driver who is under pressure of fatigue, stress, anxiety, and so on.
lines.zh: 在瑞典，人们正在研发能够在驾驶员疲劳或陷入激烈争论时接替其驾驶的自动驾驶汽车。作为欧盟770亿欧元研究计划一部分开展工作的研究人员，正在开发基于传感器的系统，用于监测驾驶员是否分心、焦虑或疲劳。如果驾驶员的状态不适合上路，汽车会自动接管方向盘，以防止发生事故。负责该项目的瑞典国家道路与运输研究所安娜·阿农博士表示，可以利用多种传感器测量驾驶员的状态，包括心率监测器和眼部传感器，后者可以追踪驾驶员的视线方向。她说，目标是真正确保从驾驶员到车辆的控制权转换以安全的方式完成，这样我们就能考虑到驾驶员的状态，也不会把控制权交给正承受疲劳、压力、焦虑等影响的驾驶员。

lines.en: According to data from the European Commission, Sweden has the safest roads in the EU, with the UK a close second. However, the number of road accidents in both has largely levelled out since 2010. Driver fatigue is thought to be responsible for as many as a fifth of road crashes across the EU, although there are certain times of the day when more accidents happen. At 6:00 a.m., for example, drivers are said to be 20 times more likely to have an accident than at 10:00 a.m. While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term, some have questioned whether it is safe.
lines.zh: 根据欧盟委员会的数据，瑞典拥有欧盟最安全的道路，英国紧随其后。不过，自2010年以来，两国的道路事故数量基本趋于平稳。据认为，驾驶员疲劳要对欧盟范围内多达五分之一的道路事故负责，尽管一天中某些时段发生的事故更多。例如，据称驾驶员在早上6点发生事故的可能性是在上午10点时的20倍。尽管大多数专家都认为，从长远来看，无人驾驶技术应有助于降低事故数量，但一些人质疑其是否安全。

lines.en: The researchers have said the technology they are developing is seeking to bridge the gap between Level 3 on the autonomy scale, in which drivers have to be ready to take control of the car at any point, and Level 4, in which driving is automated.
lines.zh: 研究人员表示，他们正在开发的技术旨在弥合自动驾驶等级体系中第3级与第4级之间的差距：在第3级，驾驶员必须随时准备接管汽车；而在第4级，驾驶过程实现自动化。

lines.en: Daniel Ruiz, the chief executive of the UK's connected and autonomous vehicle programme Meridian, said: "there is a strong debate going on about how it is possible to make a Level 3 car completely safe." Despite advances in technology, we still have some way to go in shifting public sentiment. With an increase in attention-grabbing accidents recently, drivers now view self-driving cars as less safe than they used to.
lines.zh: 英国互联与自动驾驶汽车项目Meridian的首席执行官丹尼尔·鲁伊斯说：“关于如何让第3级汽车完全安全，目前正在展开激烈的讨论。”尽管技术取得了进步，但要改变公众的看法，我们仍有一段路要走。随着近期引人关注的事故增多，如今驾驶员认为自动驾驶汽车不如过去安全。

passages.en: Two proposals are before the state legislature that look to put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices, which some lawmakers say are contributing to rising homelessness rates.
passages.zh: 州议会目前正在审议两项提案，旨在对不断上涨的租金设置一些限制。一些议员表示，租金上涨正在导致无家可归率上升。

passages.en: The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from raising rent more than the rate of inflation in most cases. There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old, public housing, improvements beyond maintenance, and a hardship __(27)__ .
passages.zh: 这些提案对租金涨幅设定上限，在大多数情况下，禁止该州房东将租金涨幅提高到超过通货膨胀率的水平。例外情况包括建成未满10年的建筑、公共住房、维护之外的改造，以及因困难而获得的豁免。

passages.en: In a 2020 study, researchers at the U.S. Government Accountability Office estimated that every $100 in rent increase is __(28)__ to a 9% rise in homelessness. Rent increases have an even more detrimental effect on some demographic groups, such as racial minorities.
passages.zh: 在2020年的一项研究中，美国政府问责署的研究人员估计，租金每上涨100美元，就与无家可归率上升9%相关。租金上涨对某些人口群体的影响更加不利，例如少数族裔。

passages.en: Representative Alex Ramel explained why he thought that this kind of legislation was so important, telling the story of a __(29)__ struggling to live in the community.
passages.zh: 亚历克斯·拉梅尔议员讲述了一名努力在当地社区生活的选民的故事，并解释了他为何认为这类立法如此重要。

passages.en: Ramel pointed out the __(30)__ effect of double-digit rent increases, saying that he made the decision to introduce the legislation while talking to a young man in Bellingham. "He's a recent graduate from Western Washington University and just got a new job," Ramel said. "He was leaving our community because his landlord __(31)__ him that his rent was going to go up by $600 a month."
passages.zh: 拉梅尔指出，两位数租金涨幅会造成毁灭性影响。他说，自己是在与贝灵厄姆的一名年轻人交谈时决定提出这项立法的。拉梅尔说：“他刚从西华盛顿大学毕业，最近找到了一份新工作。他正要离开我们的社区，因为他的房东通知他，租金每月要上涨600美元。”

passages.en: The Rental Housing Association of Washington opposes the legislation. The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices. Instead, it will punish small landlords and allow wealthy renters easy access to cheap housing.
passages.zh: 华盛顿州租赁住房协会反对这项立法。该协会声称，这项政策实际上无法解决租金问题，反而会惩罚小房东，让富裕租户轻易获得廉价住房。

passages.en: "The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county. It has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__ . It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when __(35)__ who gets the benefits of rent control," said Chester Baldwin with the Rental Housing Coalition.
passages.zh: 租赁住房联盟的切斯特·鲍德温说：“租金管制政策在这个国家所有实施过的地方都失败了。它没有在任何地方解决一个住房问题。在决定谁能从租金管制中受益时，它也不区分富人和穷人。”

rows.text: J) impose动词
复数主语 proposals 之后缺谓语，需动词原形（一般现在时）

impose caps/limits on 是政策语域的固定搭配，「对……设限」 The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from raising rent more than the rate of inflation in most cases.——提案「对租金涨幅设上限」，呼应首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，impose caps on 与 put limits on 是同义改写，这正是六级最爱考的「换说法不换意思」。
M)presumepresume 意为「假定」，与 caps 不构成搭配且逻辑相反 presume 是「假定、推测」，presume caps 不是英语搭配；且提案是「实际设限」而非「假定存在上限」，代入后与后半句 preventing landlords…（实际阻止房东涨租）矛盾。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— presume 与 impose 同为原形动词，「提案假定上限」粗读似乎也通。The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases 中 presume 形态合格，且考生若只认识 presume 不认识 impose，容易用「熟悉的词」填。防坑：盯住宾语搭配——caps/limits 的舞伴是 impose（impose caps on），presume 后接的是「事实从句」；再回看首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，同义改写的锚点直接指向 impose。
I) exemption名词
不定冠词 a + 名词作定语的 hardship 之后，需单数可数名词

hardship exemption「困难豁免」是政策文本的固定说法，且与 exceptions 同义呼应 There are exceptions for buildings less than 10 years old, public housing, improvements beyond maintenance, and a hardship __(27)__.——列举的都是「不适用该限制的豁免情形」，a hardship exemption（因困难而获得的豁免）与句首 exceptions 同义复现，政策语域用词精准。

C)constituentconstituent「选民」不能与 hardship 构成政策豁免概念 a hardship constituent 字面上是「一位困难的选民」，但本句列举的是例外「情形/类别」（建筑、公屋、改良工程），不是人；且选民不属于租金管制条例的豁免条款范畴，语义场不合。 N)rehabilitationrehabilitation 意为「康复/修复」，与 hardship 搭配不成立 hardship rehabilitation（困难修复）不是英语里的政策术语；rehabilitation 多指罪犯改造、病人康复或建筑翻修，与「豁免条款」的语境无关。
D) correlated动词
be 动词 is 之后、介词 to 之前，需过去分词构成 be done 表语结构

be correlated to 是固定搭配，意为「与……相关」，严丝合缝 研究语境 researchers at the U.S. Government Accountability Office estimated that every $100 in rent increase is __(28)__ to a 9% rise in homelessness：租金每涨 100 美元「对应/关联」无家可归率上升 9%——这正是相关性表述，be correlated to/with 是六级阅读与选词填空的高频固定搭配，语义与搭配双契合。

G)enactedenact 的搭配对象是法律而非数据关系 enacted 意为「颁布（法律）」，其主语应是立法机构、宾语是法案；「租金上涨被颁布成无家可归率上升 9%」语义不通，且 enact 不与 to 构成表语搭配。 K)notifiednotify 的对象必须是人 notify sb of/that… 意为「通知某人」，被通知方是人；这里主语是 every $100 in rent increase（物），「租金上涨被通知给无家可归率」不成立，也不与 to 搭配。
C) constituent名词
不定冠词 a 之后、分词短语 struggling… 之前，需单数可数名词指人

议员讲「选民」的艰难故事，身份与语境严丝合缝 Representative Alex Ramel explained why he thought that this kind of legislation was so important, telling the story of a __(29)__ struggling to live in the community.——说话者是 Representative（众议员），议员为自己的立法辩护时讲的是「选区选民」的故事；constituent 正是「（选区的）选民」，且下一段 he made the decision to introduce the legislation while talking to a young man in Bellingham 的 a young man 就是这个 constituent 的具体化。
N)rehabilitationrehabilitation 是抽象事物名词，不能「挣扎着生活」 rehabilitation（康复/修复）是物不是人，无法充当 struggling to live 的逻辑主语；「一个挣扎着住在社区里的康复」语义荒谬，直接排除。
F) devastating形容词
定冠词 the 与名词 effect 之间，需形容词作定语

devastating effect 是高频搭配，且与「两位数涨幅」的负面语境吻合 上下文 Ramel pointed out the __(30)__ effect of double-digit rent increases 与 Rent increases have an even more detrimental effect on some demographic groups 呼应：说话者是立法支持者，强调租金暴涨的「毁灭性」影响，devastating effect（毁灭性的影响）搭配与感情色彩双双贴合。
C)constituentconstituent 作形容词意为「组成的」，与 effect 不搭 constituent 虽有形容词用法（组成的、构成整体的），但 constituent effect 不是英语搭配；其名词义「选民」也与本空语法槽（名词前的定语形容词）语义不合。
K) notified动词
his landlord 后缺谓语，且后接双宾 him + that 从句，需及物动词过去式

notify sb that… 「通知某人……」，房东通知涨租正是此场景 He was leaving our community because his landlord __(31)__ him that his rent was going to go up by $600 a month.——他要搬离，因为房东「通知」他月租要涨 600 美元。notify sb that 从句句型严丝合缝，因果链（被通知涨租 → 被迫搬走）完全通顺。
B) asserts动词
单数主语 The association 后缺谓语，需三单动词接 that 从句

assert that… 「坚称」，正是机构表态反对的措辞 The Rental Housing Association of Washington opposes the legislation. The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices.——协会反对立法，「坚称」该政策解决不了租金问题。assert 接 that 从句表强硬主张，与前句 opposes 的反对立场无缝衔接。
H)entailsentail 是及物动词接名词性成分，不接 that 从句 entails 意为「使必要、涉及」，用法是 A entails B（B 为名词/动名词），如 The job entails travel；它没有 entail that 从句表「声称」的用法，代入后句法不成立。

最具迷惑性的错误词是 H) —— entails 与 asserts 同为三单，形态零区分度，最易凭模糊词义选错。The association __(32)__ that the policy won't actually solve the problem of rental prices. 中 entails 词性、时态全部合格，「涉及问题」的字面意思又和语境沾边，是最强干扰。防坑口诀：空后是 that 从句时先问动词能不能带宾语从句——entail 只能接名词性宾语，assert 才能接 that 从句表「坚称」，句法门槛一过见分晓。
G) enacted动词
has been 之后需过去分词，构成现在完成被动语态

法律政策「被颁布实施」用 enact，法案语域的专属动词 The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county.——租金管控政策「凡是在本县被实施过的地方都失败了」。enact 专用于「颁布法律、实施政策」，与 policy 构成最自然的被动搭配，也是说话者（反对派）论证政策无效的语义所需。
K)notifiednotify 的对象是人，政策不能被「通知」 notified 意为「被通知」，其逻辑主语必须是人（sb be notified of/that…）；it 指 policy（物），「政策被通知」语义不通。
A) anywhere副词
句子主干完整（It has not fixed one housing problem），空在句尾作状语，需副词

否定句 + anywhere = 「在任何地方都不」，承接上句 everywhere The rent control policy has failed everywhere it has been __(33)__ in this county. It has not fixed one housing problem __(34)__.——上句说政策「处处失败」，本句递进「它在任何地方都没能解决哪怕一个住房问题」。not…anywhere 是英语否定的标准搭配，与 everywhere 形成语义对仗，语气一气呵成。
L)notwithstandingnotwithstanding 表让步「尽管如此」，与本句递进逻辑冲突 notwithstanding 作副词意为「尽管如此」（表让步转折），而本句与上句是递进强调（处处失败 → 一个问题都没解决），不是让步；且 notwithstanding 通常不单独置于句尾修饰否定陈述句，代入后逻辑和句法双不通。
E) determining动词
when 引导的省略状语从句 when (it is) doing，需现在分词

determine who gets the benefits「决定谁受益」，与 distinguish 的批评逻辑一致 It also does not distinguish between rich and poor when __(35)__ who gets the benefits of rent control——批评者说该政策「在决定谁享受租金管控的好处时不区分贫富」。determine + 宾语从句（决定……）搭配自然，且与前文 it will punish small landlords and allow wealthy renters easy access to cheap housing 的批评（富人也能占便宜）完全同向。
O)reproachingreproach 意为「责备」，其对象是人且与 who gets… 从句不搭 reproach 的用法是 reproach sb (for sth)，宾语是被责备的人；「在责备谁获得好处时不区分贫富」语义拧巴——政策不会去「责备」受益人，批评的对象错位，逻辑不通。

longreading.title: 2026年6月·第1套 英语六级长篇阅读（信息匹配） 第 1 篇 · 36–45 题答案与解析

passages.en: A) For those "citizens of the world", the office can be anything from a beach hut in Brisbane to a Starbucks in Seattle, thanks to the growing prevalence of remote-based work. But roaming the globe from café to café is not without its challenges.
passages.zh: 对于那些“世界公民”来说，得益于远程办公日益普及，办公室可以是从布里斯班的一间海滩小屋到西雅图的一家星巴克之间的任何地方。但从一家咖啡馆游荡到另一家、周游世界，也并非没有挑战。

passages.en: B) When the average traveller lands in a city like Bangkok, Berlin, or Buenos Aires, their first step might be to drop their bags at their hotel and to log on to TripAdvisor to find out the hours of a popular tourist attraction or the best rooftop bar for happy hour.
passages.zh: 当普通旅行者抵达曼谷、柏林或布宜诺斯艾利斯这样的城市时，他们第一步可能是把行李放在酒店，然后登录TripAdvisor，了解热门旅游景点的开放时间，或寻找一家适合欢乐时光的最佳屋顶酒吧。

passages.en: C) But people like Pieter Levels are not your average traveller. A Dutch website developer, Levels has been living and working nomadically(像游牧民那样) in places like Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Manila for two years. With just a carry-on backpack, he chooses his location at will, based on a variety of factors—Wi-Fi speed, average temperature, exotic food and cost of living—that have little bearing on the work he actually does.
passages.zh: 但像Pieter Levels这样的人并不是普通旅行者。Levels是一名荷兰网站开发者，过去两年一直像游牧民一样生活和工作，辗转于新加坡、香港、东京和马尼拉等地。他只带一个登机背包，可以随心选择地点，依据的是各种因素——无线网络速度、平均气温、异国美食和生活成本——而这些因素与他实际从事的工作关系不大。

passages.en: D) Somewhere in his nomadic journey, Levels noticed that there was a growing need to create an online infrastructure for people like himself. That's when he created #nomads, a membership-based chat system which runs on the team communication platform known as Slack. The channel allows users to ask people in their current city the types of practical questions that a tourist would unlikely need to ask.
passages.zh: 在游牧旅程中的某个时候，Levels注意到，像他这样的人越来越需要建立一个在线基础设施。于是，他创建了#nomads，这是一个基于会员制的聊天系统，运行于名为Slack的团队沟通平台之上。这个频道允许用户向身处他们当前所在城市的人询问一些游客通常不太可能需要询问的实际问题。

passages.en: E) Members of the geographically dispersed subculture that Levels is a part of call themselves "digital nomads". They are borderless, mostly self-employed remote workers who interact with cities in a way that's entirely different from a tourist, but still doesn't quite reach the status of resident. A relatively new phenomenon, there are no hard statistics on the prevalence of digital nomads or location independent workers. But thanks to the growing prevalence of freelance(自由职业的) livelihoods, a global sharing economy and numerous digital tools, the number of people who are able to live this life is growing quickly. And in a rapidly urbanising world, where a major city in Asia increasingly offers the same comforts as one in Europe, many people are reaching the realisation they don't need to stay in one place.
passages.zh: Levels所属的这一地理上分散的亚文化群体称自己为“数字游民”。他们不受国界限制，大多是自雇的远程工作者；他们与城市互动的方式与游客完全不同，却又没有完全达到居民的身份。这是一个相对较新的现象，目前没有关于数字游民或不受地点限制的工作者普及程度的确切统计数据。但得益于自由职业生计的日益普及、全球共享经济以及众多数字工具，能够过上这种生活的人数正在迅速增加。在一个快速城市化的世界里，亚洲的一座大城市越来越能提供与欧洲城市相同的舒适条件，许多人开始意识到，他们不必一直待在同一个地方。

passages.en: F) So how does a nomad differ from a tourist or resident? In many ways, Levels says, you can think of a digital nomad like a "short-term independent expat(移居国外的人)". Unlike a resident expat, they don't work for a large multinational company in an air conditioned office building and they generally enter a country on a tourist visa, simply renewing or moving on when it expires. But unlike a tourist, they don't arrive in a foreign city without any responsibilities. Travel isn't necessarily required for them to do their jobs, but neither is staying in one place.
passages.zh: 那么，游民与游客或居民有何不同？Levels说，在许多方面，你可以把数字游民看作“短期独立外籍人士”。与居住在当地的外籍人士不同，他们不会在大型跨国公司的空调办公楼里工作，通常会持旅游签证进入一个国家，签证到期后简单地续签或继续前往下一处。但他们又不同于游客，因为他们抵达外国城市时并不是毫无责任。旅行并非他们完成工作所必需，但留在同一个地方也同样不是必需的。

passages.en: G) Janet Brent is an independent ebook designer. She says many people she knows assume she travels for work, but in reality her international destinations are largely up to her, and driven by cost. "Contrary to what some people might think, I don't get paid to travel—I simply choose the lifestyle. Rather than rent in one given city, I choose to travel and do short-term, temporary stays around the world, and my travel decisions are literally based on what makes the most sense financially for me," Brent said. "It's completely different from vacationing—you really sink into the city life and get your feet wet in the communities."
passages.zh: Janet Brent是一名独立电子书设计师。她说，她认识的许多人都认为她是因工作而旅行，但实际上，她去哪些国家主要由自己决定，并且受到成本驱动。“与一些人的想法相反，我并不是靠旅行获得报酬的——我只是选择了这种生活方式。与其在某一个城市租房，我选择旅行，在世界各地进行短期、临时的居住；从经济角度看，我的旅行决定完全取决于什么对我来说最合理，”Brent说。“这与度假完全不同——你会真正融入城市生活，并在当地社区中亲身体验。”

passages.en: H) Bryce Adams is another such nomad. He works as a developer for a South African company WooThemes, which has a workforce that's more than 80% remote-based. Though Adams frequently posts pictures on Instagram of his enviable cooking adventures from Seoul to Bangkok, he says nomad life in foreign cities has its downsides, including finding adequate Wi-Fi for the bandwidth-hungry work his livelihood depends on. Contrary to the perception that he works under a mango tree in a tropical haven, Adams says the reality of this life means that he often ends up staying in more western style places in globalised cities—ones that are sure to have air conditioning and a decent connection—rather than exotic beachfront cafés.
passages.zh: Bryce Adams也是这样的游民。他在南非公司WooThemes担任开发者，该公司超过80%的员工采取远程办公。尽管Adams经常在Instagram上发布自己从首尔到曼谷进行令人羡慕的烹饪探险的照片，但他说，在外国城市过游民生活也有不利之处，其中包括为依赖高带宽工作谋生的自己找到足够稳定的无线网络。与人们以为他在热带天堂的一棵芒果树下工作的印象相反，Adams说，这种生活的现实是，他往往最终住在全球化城市中更具西式风格的地方——那里肯定有空调和良好的网络连接——而不是待在充满异国情调的海滨咖啡馆里。

passages.en: I) "A fellow nomad posted quite a funny but honest message on Twitter a few days ago that stuck with me: 'It's funny that digital nomads spend 16 hours to fly to the other side of the world to sit in Starbucks,' and it's completely true," Adams said. "When you're a digital nomad, you don't actually have as much freedom as most people think you do. We have deadlines, we all have people relying on us and a mouth (or two) that needs to be fed. It's nice to be able to work anywhere in the world but it's not without its challenges."
passages.zh: “几天前，一位游民同伴在Twitter上发了一条相当有趣却又诚实的信息，让我一直记在心里：‘数字游民花16个小时飞到世界另一端，却坐在星巴克里。’这完全是真的，”Adams说。“当你成为数字游民时，你实际上并没有大多数人想象的那么自由。我们有截止期限，我们都有依赖我们的人，还有一张或两张需要填饱的嘴。能够在世界任何地方工作当然很好，但这并非没有挑战。”

passages.en: J) But these challenges can often provide an opportunity for nomads to see a side of a city they may not have if they were staying in a luxury hotel for a long weekend. However inconvenient, a trip to a local doctor, immigration office or laundry—or a conflict with a local Airbnb host (the accommodation style of choice for most nomads)—can be far more culturally instructive than a trip to the national museum. And because nomads often have to stay where the strongest internet connection is, they tend to spend more time in developing cities compared to the average tourist, who often flees to more touristy destinations soon after landing at the airport.
passages.zh: 但这些挑战往往能让游民有机会看到城市中不同的一面，而如果他们在一家豪华酒店度过一个长周末，可能就不会看到这一面。尽管不便，去当地的医生诊所、移民局或洗衣店，或是与当地的Airbnb房东发生冲突——Airbnb是大多数游民首选的住宿方式——都可能比参观国家博物馆更能让人从文化上获得启发。而且，由于游民往往必须住在网络连接最强的地方，与通常在抵达机场后不久就逃往更热门旅游目的地的普通游客相比，他们更倾向于在发展中城市停留更长时间。

passages.en: K) The nomad life is, by all accounts, one built out of privilege. You not only need a relatively powerful passport that makes tourist visas easy to attain, but also a knowledge economy job and access to the technology and devices that make remote working possible. But nomads like Adams say that while they are aware of this privilege, they believe living this way elevates what they're able to offer, by giving them a broader perspective on what they're building, writing, or designing and expanding their world view.
passages.zh: 无论从哪方面看，游民生活都是建立在特权之上的。你不仅需要一本相对强大的护照，以便容易获得旅游签证，还需要一份知识经济领域的工作，以及能够使远程工作成为可能的技术和设备。不过，Adams这样的游民说，尽管他们意识到这种特权的存在，他们仍相信以这种方式生活能够提升他们所能提供的价值，因为这让他们对自己正在创造、写作或设计的事物拥有更广阔的视角，也拓展了他们的世界观。

passages.en: L) "Being able to travel and get around makes it easy to stay inspired," he added. "I truly believe that it makes me a more sensible human being, as I tend to see and appreciate the creative solutions people come up with in other parts of the world, even though many tend to have far more constraints than we have at home."
passages.zh: “能够旅行和四处走动，让人很容易始终保持灵感，”他补充道。“我确实相信，这会让我成为一个更有判断力的人，因为我往往能看到并欣赏世界其他地方的人们想出的富有创造力的解决方案，尽管他们中的许多人所受到的限制远远多于我们在家乡所面临的限制。”

passages.en: M) So when you're constantly on the road and don't own any property or have a fixed address, which city do you call home? It's no surprise that many nomads are dual citizens or "third culture kids," who have grown up with a notion of identity that's not tied to nationalism or staying in one place. Levels says that the nomad life has not only changed his notions of citizenship, but the people he chooses to spend time with as well. "Saying you're a 'citizen of the world' is a super cliché, right? But it's becoming quite true," Levels said. "This global awareness has been the reason I started Nomad List and it's affected who my friends are. It's normal to have dinner now and sit with a Korean girl, a British-Singaporean guy, a Mexican girl and a Nigerian guy. As much as that sounds like a politically correct TV advertisement, it's great that that's the time we're in now."
passages.zh: 那么，当你一直在路上、不拥有任何房产、也没有固定地址时，你把哪个城市称作家呢？许多游民拥有双重国籍，或是“第三文化孩子”，这并不令人意外；他们在成长过程中形成了一种不与民族主义或固守一地相联系的身份观念。Levels说，游民生活不仅改变了他的公民身份观念，也改变了他选择与之共度时光的人。“说自己是‘世界公民’很老套，对吧？但它正逐渐成为事实，”Levels说。“这种全球意识是我创办Nomad List的原因，也影响了我的朋友圈。现在，吃晚饭时和一位韩国女孩、一位英籍新加坡人、一位墨西哥女孩以及一位尼日利亚男子同桌，是很正常的事。尽管这听起来很像政治正确的电视广告，但我们正处于这样的时代，实在是太好了。”

statements.zh: 彼得·莱弗尔斯创建了一个聊天系统，以满足数字游民对游客通常不会寻找的信息的需求。

statements.en: The first thing a typical traveller possibly does after arriving at a city is search for information online about its popular tourist attractions.
statements.zh: 一个典型的旅行者抵达一座城市后，可能做的第一件事就是上网搜索有关当地热门旅游景点的信息。

analysis.锚点: typical traveller / first thing / popular tourist attractions
analysis.定位: B 段 When the average traveller lands in a city like Bangkok, Berlin, or Buenos Aires, their first step might be to drop their bags at their hotel and to log on to TripAdvisor to find out the hours of a popular tourist attraction or the best rooftop bar for happy hour. 当普通旅行者抵达曼谷、柏林或布宜诺斯艾利斯这类城市时，他们的第一步可能是把行李放到酒店，然后登录 TripAdvisor 查询热门旅游景点的开放时间，或 happy hour 最佳屋顶酒吧。
analysis.改写: The first thing a typical traveller possibly does after arriving at a city↔When the average traveller lands in a city... their first step might be to drop their bags at their hotel and to log on to TripAdvisor 同义替换 + 具体化 search for information online about its popular tourist attractions↔log on to TripAdvisor to find out the hours of a popular tourist attraction 具体平台替换概括说法

statements.en: One digital nomad thinks their life in foreign cities has its disadvantages.
statements.zh: 一名数字游民认为，生活在外国城市也有其弊端。

analysis.定位: H 段 Though Adams frequently posts pictures on Instagram of his enviable cooking adventures from Seoul to Bangkok, he says nomad life in foreign cities has its downsides, including finding adequate Wi-Fi for the bandwidth-hungry work his livelihood depends on. 尽管 Adams 经常在 Instagram 上晒从首尔到曼谷令人羡慕的烹饪冒险照片，但他说外国城市里的游牧生活也有弊端，包括为他赖以生计的高带宽工作寻找足够的 Wi-Fi。
analysis.改写: One digital nomad thinks their life in foreign cities has its disadvantages↔he says nomad life in foreign cities has its downsides 同义词替换 their life in foreign cities↔nomad life in foreign cities 原样复现

statements.en: Travelling around helps to keep digital nomads inspired.
statements.zh: 四处旅行有助于让数字游民保持灵感。

analysis.定位: L 段 "Being able to travel and get around makes it easy to stay inspired," he added. "I truly believe that it makes me a more sensible human being, as I tend to see and appreciate the creative solutions people come up with in other parts of the world, even though many tend to have far more constraints than we have at home." "能够旅行和四处走动让人容易保持灵感，"他补充道。"我真的相信这使我成为一个更明事理的人，因为我倾向于看到并欣赏世界其他地方的人们想出的创造性解决方案，尽管他们中的许多人往往比我们在国内面临更多限制。"
analysis.改写: Travelling around helps to keep digital nomads inspired↔Being able to travel and get around makes it easy to stay inspired 同义改写 + 具体化
analysis.辨邻: K 该段讲旅行带来broader perspective和expanding their world view，是工作产出层面，与题干'保持灵感'不同。 by giving them a broader perspective on what they're building, writing, or designing and expanding their world view M 该段讲旅行带来global awareness并改变交友圈，但未提到'保持灵感'。 This global awareness has been the reason I started Nomad List

statements.en: The number of self-employed remote workers living a digital nomad's life is fast increasing.
statements.zh: 以数字游民方式生活的自雇远程工作者人数正在快速增加。

analysis.定位: E 段 A relatively new phenomenon, there are no hard statistics on the prevalence of digital nomads or location independent workers. But thanks to the growing prevalence of freelance livelihoods, a global sharing economy and numerous digital tools, the number of people who are able to live this life is growing quickly. 作为一种相对较新的现象，目前关于数字游民或地点独立工作者流行程度的硬数据还很少。但由于自由职业生活方式日益普遍、全球共享经济以及众多数字工具的出现，能够过上这种生活的人数正在快速增长。
analysis.改写: The number of self-employed remote workers living a digital nomad's life is fast increasing↔the number of people who are able to live this life is growing quickly 同义替换 + 概括 self-employed remote workers↔mostly self-employed remote workers 原样复现
analysis.辨邻: A 该段提到the growing prevalence of remote-based work，看似与题干相关，但这是背景，未说数字游民人数快速增长。 thanks to the growing prevalence of remote-based work F 该段继续描述数字游民与游客/居民的区别，提到they don't work for a large multinational company，但未涉及人数增长。 Unlike a resident expat, they don't work for a large multinational company in an air conditioned office building

statements.zh: 彼得·莱弗尔斯说，作为游民的生活不仅改变了他对公民身份的看法，也改变了他对同伴的选择。

analysis.锚点: Pieter Levels / citizenship / choice of companions
analysis.定位: M 段 Levels says that the nomad life has not only changed his notions of citizenship, but the people he chooses to spend time with as well. "Saying you're a 'citizen of the world' is a super cliché, right? But it's becoming quite true," Levels said. Levels 说，游牧生活不仅改变了他的公民观念，也改变了他选择共度时光的人。"说自己是'世界公民'非常老套，对吧？但这正变得越来越真实，"Levels 说。
analysis.改写: his life as a nomad has transformed not only his idea of citizenship↔the nomad life has not only changed his notions of citizenship 同义替换 but his choice of companions↔but the people he chooses to spend time with as well 概括上位
analysis.辨邻: A 该段提到"citizens of the world"这一说法，但未说 Levels 的公民观念因此改变。 For those "citizens of the world", the office can be anything from a beach hut in Brisbane to a Starbucks in Seattle E 该段说数字游民borderless，看似与'世界公民'相关，但未涉及 Levels 个人对交友选择的变化。 They are borderless, mostly self-employed remote workers

statements.en: Interactions with local people and institutions provide nomads with far more cultural information than a visit to the national museum.
statements.zh: 与当地人和当地机构的互动为游民提供的文化信息，远远多于参观国家博物馆所获得的信息。

analysis.锚点: local people and institutions / national museum / cultural information
analysis.定位: J 段 But these challenges can often provide an opportunity for nomads to see a side of a city they may not have if they were staying in a luxury hotel for a long weekend. However inconvenient, a trip to a local doctor, immigration office or laundry—or a conflict with a local Airbnb host (the accommodation style of choice for most nomads)—can be far more culturally instructive than a trip to the national museum. 但这些挑战往往能给游民提供机会，让他们看到如果只是在豪华酒店度长周末所看不到的城市一面。无论多么不便，去看当地医生、移民局或洗衣店，或与当地 Airbnb 房东发生冲突——这些都是大多数游民首选的住宿方式——都可能比去国家博物馆更有文化教益。

passages.en: Children's use of social media is a problem. That doesn't mean it should be stopped. While younger children should not be on platforms where 13 is the minimum age, it is neither practical nor desirable to imagine a world in which teenagers are prevented from accessing the platforms and messaging systems that the adults around them use to organise their lives.
passages.zh: 儿童使用社交媒体是一个问题。但这并不意味着应当制止这种行为。年幼的儿童不应使用最低年龄限制为13岁的社交平台，但设想这样一个世界既不现实，也不可取：青少年无法访问身边成年人用来安排生活的各种平台和消息系统。

passages.en: But the pleasure and stimulation that people of all ages find on their screens and smartphones must not blind us to the harm that spending time in this way can cause. The finding that the alarmingly high rate of depression in British teenage girls is closely correlated to time spent on social media is extremely concerning. Research found that two in five girls are on social media for at least three hours a day—with half as many boys engaged to the same extent. More than a third of depressed girls have experienced online harassment. About half of affected girls suffered disrupted sleep, compared with 20% of depressed boys.
passages.zh: 不过，各个年龄段的人从屏幕和智能手机中获得的愉悦与刺激，不应使我们忽视以这种方式消磨时间可能造成的伤害。英国少女抑郁症发病率高得令人担忧，而这一现象与花在社交媒体上的时间密切相关，这一发现极其令人忧虑。研究发现，五分之二的女孩每天使用社交媒体至少三个小时，而达到同等程度的男孩只有这一比例的一半。超过三分之一的抑郁女孩曾遭受网络骚扰。受到影响的女孩中，约有一半睡眠受到干扰，而抑郁男孩中这一比例为20%。

passages.en: Although the research does not prove that social media causes depression, the importance of the finding that there is a connection should not be underestimated. Schools have done important work in communicating key messages about the risks of online abuse. But when it comes to broader questions about "screen time", many professionals as well as parents are confused and uncertain.
passages.zh: 尽管这项研究并未证明社交媒体会导致抑郁，但不能低估“二者存在关联”这一发现的重要性。学校在传达有关网络虐待风险的重要信息方面已经开展了重要工作。但是，在涉及有关“屏幕时间”的更广泛问题时，许多专业人士和家长一样，都感到困惑和不确定。

passages.en: The health secretary, Matt Hancock, wants official guidelines on time and age limits. This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a greater degree of differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and it all depends on what you are doing. Also due this year is information commissioner Elizabeth Denham's Age Appropriate Design Code, covering the use of children's personal data. Both initiatives are welcome. But the government is playing catch-up. Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue. The failure to protect children from data harvesting and targeted advertising thus far is as shocking as the lack of concern shown by the companies themselves with regard to children's psychological health.
passages.zh: 卫生大臣马特·汉考克希望制定关于使用时间和年龄限制的官方指导方针。这一想法的优点在于简单明了，尽管一些专家质疑其效果，并呼吁进行更大程度的区分，认为上网本身并不是坏事，关键在于你在网上做什么。此外，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆制定的《适龄设计规范》也将于今年出台，内容涉及儿童个人数据的使用。这两项举措都值得欢迎。但政府一直在追赶。对数字媒体巨头进行法定监管早就应当实施。迄今为止未能保护儿童免受数据收集和定向广告侵害，这一点令人震惊，正如相关企业本身对儿童心理健康表现出的漠不关心同样令人震惊。

passages.en: Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services. There are other reasons for the rising incidence of depression in young people, with increasing pressure to succeed in education and in life more broadly—to be famous, beautiful, rich—often cited as a source of unhappiness or anxiety which can, if aggravated by other factors and not managed, tip into ill health. Safeguarding means more than the avoidance of physical threat.
passages.zh: 当然，社交媒体公司并不是我们所有问题的根源，也可能成为那些急于转移公众对资源不足的学校和医疗服务关注的政客们一个过于容易的目标。年轻人抑郁症发病率上升还有其他原因。人们常常认为，日益增加的教育压力以及在更广泛的生活中取得成功的压力——成为名人、美丽而富有——是不快乐或焦虑的来源；如果这些情绪受到其他因素加剧且没有得到妥善处理，就可能恶化为健康问题。保护儿童意味着不仅要避免身体上的威胁。

locate.zh: 尽管这项研究并未证明社交媒体导致抑郁，但'两者存在关联'这一发现的重要性不应被低估。

option_analysis.note: 原文说 Schools have done important work in communicating key messages about the risks of online abuse.——传达网络虐待风险是学校的已有工作；Its implications about online abuse are obvious. 声称该发现对网络虐待的'启示显而易见'，obvious 在原文无任何对应，且与后文 many professionals as well as parents are confused and uncertain 的'困惑不确定'相抵触。
作者的评价止步于'重要性不应被低估'；Its key message calls for immediate attention. 进一步主张'需要立即关注/行动'，immediate 这层紧迫性是选项自行加码——第二段的 is extremely concerning 虽令人担忧，但也不等于'要求立即处置'。
预判'重要性不应被低估'与 Its importance should not be undervalued. 仅一词之差（underestimated→undervalued），是本卷最直白的一组同义替换，锁定 C。

pairs.orig: the importance of the finding that there is a connection should not be underestimated
pairs.opt: Its importance should not be undervalued.

option_analysis.note: Its uncertainty should not go unnoticed. 揪住'不确定性'不放，但这正是 Although 从句 the research does not prove that social media causes depression 里作者主动让步、并用主句压过去的内容；作者强调的是重要性，不是提醒人们注意不确定性，选项与作者着力的方向相反。

questions.stem: What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea?
questions.stem_zh: 专家如何看待卫生大臣 Matt Hancock 的想法？

options.text: Its implementation requires prompt action.
options.zh: 其实施需要迅速采取行动。

options.text: It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue.
options.zh: 这是一项值得欢迎的倡议，但早就应该提出了。

options.text: Its success depends on how it is implemented.
options.zh: 其成败取决于实施方式。

options.text: It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect.
options.zh: 这一想法过于简单化，无法产生预期效果。

questions.判型: What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea? 主体（experts）与对象（Hancock's idea）都明确可定位，是观点类细节题；只是正确项需要把原文两处评价整合后认出，比对要求更高。
questions.拆句: Q49 主干 What do experts think，of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea 限定对象；health secretary 是 Matt Hancock 的同位语官衔，'s idea 表明考的是专家对其提议的评价，不是对 Hancock 本人的评价。
questions.定位: P4 This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a greater degree of differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and it all depends on what you are doing. 这个想法有简单这一优点，不过一些专家质疑其效果，并主张更大程度的区别对待，理由是上网时间本身并非坏事，关键在于你在做什么。

locate.en: This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a greater degree of differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and it all depends on what you are doing.
locate.zh: 这个想法有简单这一优点，不过一些专家质疑其效果，并主张更大程度的区别对待，理由是上网时间本身并非坏事，关键在于你在做什么。

option_analysis.note: Its implementation requires prompt action. 称实施需要迅速行动，但专家对效果的质疑与'快慢'无关，prompt action 在原文没有任何对应表述，属于凭空添加的主张。

It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue. 里，welcome 出自作者对两项举措的总评 Both initiatives are welcome.，long overdue 出自作者对监管巨头滞后的批评 Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue.——两句都是作者的声音，且 overdue 说的还不是这个想法本身；题干问的是专家。
原文专家说 it all depends on what you are doing——效果取决于你在网上做什么（内容），Its success depends on how it is implemented. 偷换成'取决于如何实施'；depends on 句型原样照搬，宾语却被整个换掉。
预判'太简单、难奏效'正是 It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect. 的字面意思，且每一半都能在定位句找到出处（simplicity / question its effects），锁定 D。

questions.stem: Besides social media companies, what factors contribute to young people's psychological health problems?
questions.stem_zh: 除了社交媒体公司之外，还有哪些因素导致年轻人的心理健康问题？

options.text: Poorly financed schools and health services.
options.zh: 资金不足的学校和医疗服务。

options.text: Politicians' eagerness to divert public attention.
options.zh: 政客们急于转移公众注意力。

options.text: Bad statutory regulation of digital media giants.
options.zh: 对数字媒体巨头不完善的法定监管。

options.text: Their parents' educational background and life.
options.zh: 他们父母的教育背景和生活状况。

questions.判型: Besides social media companies, what factors contribute to young people's psychological health problems? 问文中列举了哪些其他成因，有明确的列举句可查，属细节题。
questions.拆句: Q50 主干 what factors contribute to young people's psychological health problems，句首 Besides social media companies 是介词短语作排除限定。contribute to 表示'促成'，问的是成因；Besides 是全题题眼，决定答案不能落在社交媒体公司头上。
questions.定位: P5 Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services. 当然，社交媒体公司并非我们所有问题的根源，而且它们很容易成为政客们的靶子——政客热衷于借此转移人们对投入不足的学校和医疗服务的关注。

locate.en: Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services.
locate.zh: 当然，社交媒体公司并非我们所有问题的根源，而且它们很容易成为政客们的靶子——政客热衷于借此转移人们对投入不足的学校和医疗服务的关注。

option_analysis.note: 预判候选'投入不足的学校与医疗服务'与 Poorly financed schools and health services. 仅修饰语有别，主体名词逐字相同，且它确属'社交媒体公司以外'的因素，锁定 A。

pairs.orig: inadequately resourced schools and health services
pairs.opt: Poorly financed schools and health services.

option_analysis.note: Politicians' eagerness to divert public attention. 取自 politicians keen to divert attention，但政客转移视线是对问题的掩盖手段，不是导致年轻人心理问题的成因；题干问的是 contribute to 心理问题的因素，此项答非所问。

Bad statutory regulation of digital media giants. 借自 P4 Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue.——监管缺位针对的正是数字媒体巨头本身，属于'社交媒体公司'这一条线，而题干用 Besides social media companies 明确把这条线排除在外；且 P5 列举的其他原因里也根本没有它。

原文的另一成因是 increasing pressure to succeed in education and in life more broadly——年轻人自己在教育和人生上的成功压力；Their parents' educational background and life. 把 education and life 的原词留下，却硬是安上 parents' 这个原文没有的主体，把'自身压力'偷换成'父母背景'。

reading2.title: 2026年6月·第1套 英语六级阅读理解（四选一） 第 2 篇 · 51–55 题答案与解析

passages.en: About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities.
passages.zh: 大约十年前，作为世界最大经济体论坛的二十国集团同意严厉打击跨国公司滥用避税天堂的行为。这促成了一项计划，旨在遏制那些使企业利润中的很大一部分逃避税务机关监管的做法。

passages.en: But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse.
passages.zh: 然而，避税天堂的使用非但没有得到遏制——避税天堂包括巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国家和地区——这一问题反而变得更加严重。

passages.en: In a new study, we measured the excessive profits reported in tax havens that cannot be explained by ordinary economic activity such as employees, factories and research in that country. Our findings show a striking pattern of artificial shifting of paper profits to tax havens by corporations, which has been relentless since the 1980s.
passages.zh: 在一项最新研究中，我们测算了避税天堂申报的超额利润，其中有一部分无法用该国的雇员、工厂和研发等正常经济活动来解释。我们的研究结果显示，企业将账面利润人为转移至避税天堂的现象十分明显，而且自20世纪80年代以来一直持续不断。

passages.en: We found that the world's biggest multinational businesses shifted 37% of the profits—$969 billion—they earned in other countries to tax havens in 2019. The figure was less than 2% in the 1970s. The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens.
passages.zh: 我们发现，2019年，全球最大的跨国企业将其在其他国家赚取的利润中的37%（9690亿美元）转移到了避税天堂。20世纪70年代，这一比例还不到2%。这一比例大幅上升的主要原因，是20世纪80年代避税行业的发展，以及美国的相关政策使得企业更容易将利润从高税率国家转移到避税天堂。

passages.en: We estimate that the amount of corporate taxes lost as a result reached 10% of total corporate revenue in 2019, up from less than 0.1% in the 1970s. In 2019, the total government tax loss globally was $250 billion. U.S. multinational corporations alone accounted for about half of that, followed by the U.K. and Germany.
passages.zh: 我们估计，2019年因此损失的企业税额已达到企业总收入的10%，而20世纪70年代还不到0.1%。2019年，全球政府税收损失总额为2500亿美元。其中，仅美国跨国公司就占了约一半，其后是英国和德国。

passages.en: How do policymakers fix this? So far, the world as a whole has been trying to solve this problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way. In the past 40 years, the global effective corporate tax rate has fallen from 23% to 17%. At the same time, governments have relied more heavily on consumption taxes.
passages.zh: 政策制定者应如何解决这一问题？到目前为止，世界各国总体上一直试图通过非常渐进地削减或取消企业税来解决这一问题。在过去40年里，全球企业实际税率已从23%降至17%。与此同时，各国政府越来越依赖消费税。

passages.en: But the root cause of profit-shifting is the incentives involved, such as generous or lenient corporate tax rates in other countries. If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist.
passages.zh: 但利润转移的根本原因在于相关激励措施，例如其他国家慷慨或宽松的企业税率。如果各国能够就全球最低企业税率达成一致，比如确定为20%，利润转移问题将基本消失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。

passages.en: This type of mechanism is exactly what more than 130 countries signed onto in 2021, with implementation of a 15% minimum tax set to begin soon in the EU, U.K., Japan, Indonesia and many other countries. The U.S. has notably not been able to pass this legislation.
passages.zh: 这类机制正是2021年由130多个国家签署支持的方案；欧盟、英国、日本、印度尼西亚以及许多其他国家将很快开始实施15%的最低税率。值得注意的是，美国一直未能通过这项立法。

passages.en: Our research suggests implementing this type of tax reform is necessary in reversing the shift of ever-greater amounts of corporate profits to tax havens—instead of being taxed by the governments where they operate and create value.
passages.zh: 我们的研究表明，实施这类税制改革对于扭转企业利润越来越多地流向避税天堂的趋势是必要的；这些利润本应由企业开展经营并创造价值所在国的政府征税。

questions.stem: What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens?
questions.stem_zh: 我们从G20遏制避税天堂使用的协议中了解到什么？

options.text: It has aggravated the problem in non-G-20 countries.
options.zh: 加剧了非G20国家的问题。

options.text: It has taken a toll on countries such as Cayman Islands.
options.zh: 对开曼群岛等国家造成了损失。

options.text: It has failed to achieve the expected outcome.
options.zh: 未能达到预期效果。

options.text: It has failed to result in any long-term plan.
options.zh: 未能形成任何长期计划。

questions.判型: What do we learn about the G-20's agreement...? 询问关于该协议的事实信息，没有 infer/suggest/imply 等推断标志。
questions.拆句: What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens? 为主谓宾结构，介词 on 后接动名词短语作后置修饰，整体无否定、比较等陷阱，平铺直叙。
questions.定位: P1 About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities. But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse. 大约十年前，世界最大经济体论坛 G-20 同意打击跨国企业滥用避税天堂的行为。这产生了一项计划，旨在遏制将大量企业利润 shield 在税务机关之外的做法。但是，非但没有遏制避税天堂的使用——例如巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国家——问题反而变得更糟。

locate.en: About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities. But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse.
locate.zh: 大约十年前，世界最大经济体论坛 G-20 同意打击跨国企业滥用避税天堂的行为。这产生了一项计划，旨在遏制将大量企业利润 shield 在税务机关之外的做法。但是，非但没有遏制避税天堂的使用——例如巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国家——问题反而变得更糟。

option_analysis.note: 原文只说 the problem has only gotten worse，未限定问题恶化的地理范围；选项凭空添加 non-G-20 countries。
原文 countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands 是 tax havens 的举例，选项却把它们说成协议的受害者。
It has failed to achieve the expected outcome. 准确概括了 计划旨在遏制 与 问题反而恶化 之间的转折关系。

pairs.orig: agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices
the problem has only gotten worse

option_analysis.note: 原文 This resulted in a plan 明确说明协议产生了计划，选项却说 failed to result in any long-term plan。

questions.stem: What mainly accounted for the large increase in the world's biggest multinational corporations' shift of profits to tax havens?
questions.stem_zh: 是什么主要导致世界上最大的跨国公司将利润转移至避税天堂的行为大幅增加？

options.text: Fluctuating tax rates globally.
options.zh: 全球税率波动。

options.text: Lenient policies of the U.S.
options.zh: 美国宽松的政策。

options.text: Heavy taxes imposed on them.
options.zh: 对它们征收的高额税款。

options.text: Rapid growth of their business.
options.zh: 其业务的快速增长。

questions.判型: What mainly accounted for...? 直接询问导致某现象的主要原因，属于因果型细节题。
questions.拆句: What mainly accounted for the large increase in the world's biggest multinational corporations' shift of profits to tax havens? 中，mainly accounted for 是因果谓语，in... 是 the large increase 的后置定语，整体问的是利润转移大幅增长的主因。
questions.定位: P4 The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens. 大幅增长的主要原因是 1980 年代避税产业的兴起，以及美国政策使得将利润从高税率国家转移到避税天堂变得更容易。

locate.en: The main reasons for the large increase were the growth of the tax avoidance industry in the 1980s and U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens.
locate.zh: 大幅增长的主要原因是 1980 年代避税产业的兴起，以及美国政策使得将利润从高税率国家转移到避税天堂变得更容易。

option_analysis.note: 原文只提到全球有效企业税率从 23% 降至 17%，这是单向下降而非 fluctuating（波动），更非利润转移激增的主因。
Lenient policies of the U.S. 是 U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits... 的同义概括。

pairs.orig: U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens
shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens
pairs.opt: shift of profits to tax havens

option_analysis.note: 原文 high-tax countries 指税率较高的国家，选项却偷换为 Heavy taxes imposed on them（对企业征收重税），将国家属性错误地套到企业上。
原文 growth 的主语是 the tax avoidance industry，选项却改成 their business（跨国企业业务），主体被替换。

questions.stem: What have policymakers been doing to prevent government tax loss?
questions.stem_zh: 政策制定者一直在采取什么措施来防止政府税收流失？

options.text: Reducing corporate taxes step by step.
options.zh: 逐步降低企业税。

options.text: Scrapping consumption taxes gradually.
options.zh: 逐步取消消费税。

options.text: Making joint efforts to levy corporate taxes.
options.zh: 共同努力征收企业税。

options.text: Adjusting global effective corporate tax rates.
options.zh: 调整全球有效企业税率。

questions.判型: What have policymakers been doing...? 询问主体已采取的行动，属于事实型细节题。
questions.拆句: What have policymakers been doing to prevent government tax loss? 为现在完成进行时，强调动作从过去持续到现在，to prevent... 表目的，句法较平实。
questions.定位: P6 So far, the world as a whole has been trying to solve this problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way. 到目前为止，全世界作为一个整体，一直在试图通过以非常渐进的方式削减或取消企业所得税来解决这个问题。

locate.en: So far, the world as a whole has been trying to solve this problem by cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way.
locate.zh: 到目前为止，全世界作为一个整体，一直在试图通过以非常渐进的方式削减或取消企业所得税来解决这个问题。

option_analysis.note: Reducing corporate taxes step by step. 是 cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way 的简洁同义改写。

pairs.orig: cutting or scrapping corporate taxes in a very gradual way
pairs.opt: Reducing corporate taxes step by step.

option_analysis.note: 原文 governments have relied more heavily on consumption taxes 说明政府更依赖消费税，而非取消消费税。
原文说 cutting or scrapping corporate taxes（削减或取消企业所得税），选项却说 making joint efforts to levy corporate taxes（联合征收企业所得税），方向相反且添加 joint efforts 这一未提及信息。
原文 the global effective corporate tax rate has fallen from 23% to 17% 是削减企业所得税后的结果，选项却把它说成政策制定者'正在做的事'本身。

questions.stem: What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end?
questions.stem_zh: 作者说什么将终结避税天堂？

options.text: The alignment of corporate taxes with consumption taxes.
options.zh: 使企业税与消费税保持一致。

options.text: The implementation of generous tax rates in all countries.
options.zh: 在所有国家实行优惠税率。

options.text: The agreement on the root cause of global profit-shifting.
options.zh: 就全球利润转移的根本原因达成一致。

options.text: The imposition of a global minimum corporate tax rate.
options.zh: 征收全球最低企业税率。

questions.判型: What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end? 直接询问作者提出的条件与结果，没有 infer/suggest 等推断标志。
questions.拆句: What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end? 中，What 引导宾语从句，would bring... to an end 是固定短语表'使...终结'，整体询问作者提出的充分条件。
questions.定位: P7 If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist. 如果各国能就比如说 20% 的全球最低企业所得税率达成一致，利润转移问题就会基本消失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。

locate.en: If countries could agree on a global minimum corporate tax rate of, say, 20%, the problem of profit-shifting would largely disappear, as tax havens would simply cease to exist.
locate.zh: 如果各国能就比如说 20% 的全球最低企业所得税率达成一致，利润转移问题就会基本消失，因为避税天堂将不复存在。

option_analysis.note: 原文 P6 提到企业所得税与消费税并存，但从未说二者需要 alignment（协调一致）来终结避税天堂。

translation.directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate a passage from Chinese into English. You should write your answer on Answer Sheet 2.
translation.source_zh: 科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患 者病史，避免重复检查。线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
translation.reference_en:
Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical services. In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients. Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis. The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations. Online medical consultation platforms have also greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care. Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's health needs.
【衔接】
第1、2句间用时间状语承接近年来自带时间推进，译 In recent years 置于第2句句首，自然把远程医疗这个实例挂到首句得到快速发展的总起之后，无需另加关联词。
四个并列实例句群，只在末例补 also第3至6句是四个并列的应用实例（远程咨询、AI诊断、电子档案、线上平台），若每句都加 moreover／in addition 会关联词堆砌、反而生硬；只在最后一例句首补一个 also（Online medical consultation platforms have also...），标示「再举一例、举例将尽」，轻重得当。
总结句前补 Overall末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求是对前文的收束，中文靠语序暗示、英文需显性标记，句首补 Overall（Overall, the deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met...），把「举例→总结」的信息流显化给阅卷人。

main_idea.core: 科技赋能中国医疗的正式客观介绍
main_idea.detail: P1是典型的六级式社会科技介绍段：首句科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展总起，中间逐一举远程医疗、人工智能诊断、电子健康档案、线上平台四个应用实例，末句科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求收束升华。语体正式客观，英文用词应偏书面（consultation、facilitate 优于口语说法），句式以主谓主干句为主。

tense.detail: 通篇客观介绍科技给中国医疗带来的现状与功能，陈述的是当下的一般事实与能力，如可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询、帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，故全篇以一般现在时为基调；凡带「了」「近年来」、表示已成结果的句子（如得到快速发展、极大地方便了患者就诊）合理偏离为现在完成时，表示动作已发生且结果延续至今。

term_notes.detail: 统一译作 advances in science and technology（约定俗成的固定搭配，advances 用复数表「多方面的进步」），锚回科技进步，全篇不再换用 technology development 等自造说法。
统一译作 medical services（也可作 healthcare，但全篇只取 medical services 一种），锚回医疗事业；「事业」在此语境下不译 cause/undertaking。
统一译作 telemedicine，这是国际通用的约定俗成译名，锚回远程医疗；不要自造 long-distance medical care 这类中式表达。
统一译作 high-quality medical resources（resources 用复数），锚回优质医疗资源。
统一译作 remote areas，作后置定语时为 in remote areas，锚回偏远地区患者。

term_notes.core: 人工智能辅助诊断系统
term_notes.detail: 统一译作 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（AI-assisted 为连字符复合形容词，systems 复数表一类事物），锚回人工智能辅助诊 断系统；AI 为公认缩写，正式译文中可直接使用。
统一译作 electronic health records（records 用复数），锚回电子健康档案，即国际通用的 EHR，全篇不混用 electronic medical files。
统一译作 online medical consultation platforms（platforms 复数），锚回线上医疗咨询平台；「咨询」取书面词 consultation，不用 asking doctors 这类口语。
统一译作 treatment plans（plans 复数），锚回治疗方案。

steps.text: 科技进步作主语，带来作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展的核心动作是「使……得到快速发展」，提主干为 Advances in science and technology（主语）+ have brought about（谓语）+ the rapid development of China's medical services（宾语）；「中国的医疗事业」整体降为宾语内部的修饰成分。

「使……得到发展」并入一个及物动词「使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展」不宜逐字译成 make China's medical services get developed（典型中式英语），把「快速发展」做成名词短语 the rapid development of China's medical services 作宾语，用一个及物动词 brought about（带来）即可完整承载「使……得到」的因果语义。

时态得到快速发展表示已发生且延续至今的结果，此处偏离全篇一般现在时的基调，改用现在完成时 have brought about；若用一般现在时 brings about，会丢掉「已然实现」的意味。 主谓一致主语中心词 advances 是复数，助动词用 have，不要误写为 has。 冠词与单复数development 被 of China's medical services 限定为特指，前面加 the；medical services 用复数表医疗服务的统称。
Advances in science and technology have brought about the rapid development of China's medical services.

远程医疗作主语，使资源可及作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者的主语「远程医疗」照搬为 telemedicine；「使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者」用英文惯用复合宾语结构 has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients——「惠及」没有一个逐字对应的英文动词，make sth accessible to sb 是地道对译。
「近年来」降为时间状语前置本句主干之外只有近年来一个成分，译为时间状语 In recent years 置于句首，既符合英文把时间状语放句首标示话题的习惯，又天然起到承接上句的作用；句内其余部分无需再降级。
时态「近年来」标示从过去持续到现在，是现在完成时的典型信号，用 has made；这是基调时态的合理偏离。 主谓一致主语 telemedicine 是不可数单数，助动词用 has，不要受中文无单复数标记影响写成 have。 单复数「优质医疗资源」「更多患者」均为复数概念：high-quality medical resources、more patients，patients 不要漏掉 s。
In recent years, telemedicine has made high-quality medical resources accessible to more patients.
医学专家作主语，提供咨询作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询给出明确主语「医学专家」→medical experts，谓语取「提供咨询」→can provide consultations；后半句指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案不另立谓语，留给降级处理。

方式状语前置，伴随动作分词化「通过视频」→介词短语 Through video links 作方式状语置句首；「为偏远地区患者」→for patients in remote areas，其中「偏远地区」用介词短语 in remote areas 作 patients 的后置定语，不堆在名词前；「指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案」→现在分词短语 guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans 作伴随状语，「制定并实施」在 guide sb in doing sth 框架内用 and 连接两个动名词。

时态与情态回指全篇基调用一般现在时，can 后接动词原形 provide；本句陈述的是当下的能力，不用完成时。 介词搭配provide sth for sb（为某人提供某物）与 guide sb in doing sth（指导某人做某事）是固定搭配，介词 for／in 不可换、不可省。 单复数consultations、treatment plans 均用复数表泛指的一类；experts、doctors 复数与中文「专家们／医生们」的群体义一致。
Through video links, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas, guiding local doctors in developing and implementing treatment plans.
诊断系统作主语，帮助识别作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）人工智能辅助诊 断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状主语照搬为 AI-assisted diagnosis systems（systems 复数表一类事物），谓语用 help sb do 结构：help doctors identify patients' early symptoms；「识别」紧跟 help 用原形。
「提高准确率」降为结果状语提高诊断准确率是「帮助识别早期症状」带来的结果，译为 thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis 作结果状语挂句尾；「诊断准确率」不直译为 diagnosis correct rate（中式），用 the accuracy of diagnosis 这个名词化表达。

时态陈述系统的一般功能，回指全篇基调用一般现在时 help。 动词用法help 后接不带 to 的不定式：help doctors identify（to identify 也算对，但 identify 更简洁）；不要误写 help doctors identifying。 单复数systems、doctors、symptoms 均用复数；symptoms 最易漏 s，注意「患者的早期症状」是多个症状。
AI-assisted diagnosis systems help doctors identify patients' early symptoms, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis.

普及作主语，使医生能够作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）电子健康档案的普及是「动词＋的＋名词」结构，译成名词化短语 The widespread adoption of electronic health records 作整句主语；「让医生能够」用 enable sb to do：enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories。
「避免重复检查」降为结果状语避免重复检查是「快速了解病史」的直接结果，用 thus avoiding repeated examinations 作结果状语挂句尾；「让」译作 enable sb to do 已含「能够」义，「能够」不再另译 can，避免 enable...to be able to 的冗余。
主谓一致主语中心词是 adoption（单数），不是 records，谓语用 enables——长主语里隔着 of 短语时，最容易被末尾的复数名词带偏。 时态陈述现实功能，回指基调用一般现在时。 单复数records、histories 用复数；「病史」也可作 a patient's medical history，两种译法取一即可，全篇保持可数名词标记完整。
The widespread adoption of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly review patients' medical histories, thus avoiding repeated examinations.

平台作主语，方便就诊作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊主语照搬为 Online medical consultation platforms；「方便了患者就诊」不逐字译 convenient for patients to see doctors（中式且破碎），用 facilitate ＋名词化宾语：have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care。
「极大地」作副词修饰谓语本句结构简单，无需降级：「极大地」→副词 greatly 直接修饰谓语动词；「患者就诊」名词化为 patients' access to medical care 作宾语，access to 是固定搭配。
时态「方便了」表已成事实且影响延续，偏离基调用现在完成时 have facilitated。 主谓一致与单复数主语 platforms 复数，助动词用 have；platforms 的 s 不可漏。 介词搭配access to 中的 to 是介词固定搭配，不可换成 for 或 of。
Online medical consultation platforms have greatly facilitated patients' access to medical care.
深度融合作主语，满足需求作谓语（主语策略：原句主语）科技与医疗的深度融合译成名词化主语 The deep integration of technology and healthcare（integration 为中心词）；谓语「满足了」→has met；宾语人民的健康需求→people's health needs，needs 用复数。
「更好地」作副词嵌入谓语本句为简单句，无成分需降级：「更好地」→better 置于助动词与过去分词之间（has better met），修饰「满足」的程度。

主谓一致主语中心词 integration 是单数，助动词用 has；不要被 of 后面的 technology and healthcare 两个名词带成 have。 时态「更好地满足了」呼应全篇「已经实现的成果」，用现在完成时 has met，与首句 have brought about 首尾呼应。 单复数「健康需求」是多种需求，needs 用复数；meet one's needs 为固定搭配。
The deep integration of technology and healthcare has better met people's health needs.
